subject: Co-sponsor trial fund — operational clarifications and next steps
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@cloudmosaic.io>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 4 Sep 2028 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Co-sponsor request for Q4 accelerator cohort (pilot credits)

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the intro at KubeCon — Cloud Mosaic is kicking off a small accelerator cohort in October and we want Redwood to be a featured compute partner. The accelerator offers 10 early-stage startups 3 months of infrastructure support; we’d like to include a trial credit line for each company to spin up inference experiments.

We typically co-fund partner credits (partner 50% / vendor 50%) for new cohorts. Can Redwood commit $20k in platform credits to be split across the 10 companies, conditional on a short attestation and logo usage?

Attached is our normal NOP (notice of participation) credit sheet for reference. We’d need a one-page acceptance and a billing contact to set up the voucher pool.

Happy to hop on a 30m call if helpful.

Best,
Elena
Elena Morales
Head of Ecosystem, Cloud Mosaic
elena@cloudmosaic.io

Attachment: CloudMosaic_NOP_creditsheet.xlsx (spreadsheet, 23KB)

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 4 Sep 2028 12:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Co-sponsor request for Q4 accelerator cohort (pilot credits)

Team — forwarding Cloud Mosaic ask. High level: 10 startups, $20k requested from Redwood, conditional on standard attestation and logo placement.

Questions for ops and finance before I reply:
- Can Partner Credits team authorize $20k in pooled trial credits for a partner co-sponsorship (we usually do $10k for programs like this)?
- Is there any policy on per-company caps (we typically cap at $2k-3k per startup for accelerator trials).
- What contract or acceptance language do we require (attestation + usage clause ok?), and who signs?

Kimberly — can you run a quick ops compliance check? Ben — thoughts on whether sales prefers a voucher vs a time-limited extension? Tessa — any conflict with current accelerator partners this quarter?

Thanks — I want to get back to Elena by EOD PT if possible.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Partner Programs | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
(650) 555-0116

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 4 Sep 2028 13:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Co-sponsor request for Q4 accelerator cohort (pilot credits)

Vanessa,

Quick ops/controls note: we can approve a $20k pooled credit only with the following guardrails in place — this is aligned with past accelerator co-sponsors but documentation must be complete:

Checklist (must have before credits are issued):
- Signed attestation form from partner (logo & PR ok) — we need contact + signatory name
- Per-startup cap set in billing pool (recommend $2k max per startup to keep runway consistent)
- Voucher expiry set to 6 months from activation; credits liquidate after expiry
- Usage telemetry enabled for the cohort (we ingest minimal metadata — project name + org id)
- Finance PO or internal charge code for the $20k (partner credits come out of partner promotions budget)

I’ve looped in Finance playbook links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-credit-pack and created a Jira to track approvals: PA-1423.

Attachments: proposed-co-sponsor-terms.docx (template acceptance language)

If Ben wants to push for a 3-month trial extension instead of credits we need to confirm: whether extension counts against active promo commitments and whether it’s automatable per-account. Ops prefers voucher pool for easier accounting.

Kimberly Park
Partner Programs Operations | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 4 Sep 2028 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Co-sponsor request for Q4 accelerator cohort (pilot credits)

Agree with ops — voucher pool is cleaner. A few sales considerations:
- If we make it a voucher pool with $2k per startup max, the cohort may hit $20k but we should ask for minimal qualification (incubator email + short use-case) so credits land in accounts that will actually run inference (not just token peeks).
- Alternative: offer a 6-month trial extension on Redwood Dedicated or Hosted with pre-approved model/instance sizes. Extension has higher perceived value for startups and is easier for them to use, but it complicates tracking and our SLAs.
- Recommend: voucher pool $20k, $2k cap, require attestation + cohort participant list by Oct 1, and telemetry tag so CSM can follow up.

If everyone agrees, Vanessa — I can draft the stock reply to Elena and include the activation timeline.

Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, West Region | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: Elena Morales <elena@cloudmosaic.io>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 5 Sep 2028 09:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Co-sponsor request for Q4 accelerator cohort (pilot credits)

Hi Elena — thanks for the ask and the NOP sheet. We’re excited to partner on the cohort.

We can commit to a $20k voucher pool split across the 10 startups under the following terms (ops & finance approved):
- Voucher pool: $20,000 Redwood credits, max $2,000 per startup.
- Expiry: credits expire 6 months from activation.
- Requirements: signed attestation (template attached), list of participating startups and their contact emails by Oct 1, and permission to include Redwood in cohort materials and a short quote.
- Telemetry: please provide a cohort tag so our CSMs can monitor usage; we will collect only project name + org id for usage reporting.

Next steps:
1) Sign the attached acceptance (proposed-co-sponsor-terms.docx) and return to finance@redwood.ai.
2) Share the participant list by Oct 1.
3) We’ll issue vouchers within 5 business days of receiving the signed form and list.

If you’d prefer a time-limited trial extension instead of vouchers, we can discuss, but vouchers are simplest for activation and reporting.

Thanks — excited to make this cohort a success.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Partner Programs | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai

Attachment: proposed-co-sponsor-terms.docx (template acceptance language)
